spans.s:
शिर् शिर्, ईर्, ईर्, ईर् (fr. rt. शॄ, cf. गिर् fr. rt.
1. गॄ), hurting, injuring, wounding; [cf. शशीश-
शिशु-शीः, Kirāt.
XV. 5
शीर् शीर्. See शिर्.
शिर शिर. See col. 2.

शिर, अस्, m. the head, (according to some अम्, n.);
the root of the pepper plant, (according to some
अम्, n.); a bed, couch (= शय्या); a large serpent.
—शिर-ज, अस्, m. ‘head-produced,’ the hair of the
head.

शिरा शिरा, f. (probably another form of
शिला, col. 3), any tubular vessel of the body, a nerve,
tendon, fibre, gut, vein, blood-vessel, artery (=
धमनि).
—शिरा-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the elephant or
wood-apple, Feronia Elephantum (= कपित्थ); a
kind of tree (= हिन्ताल).
—शिरा-वृत्त, अम्, n.
lead (= सीसक).
शीर 1. शीर, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
II. 13
. fr. rt. 1. शी), a large snake, the boa constrictor.

शीर 2. शीर, अस्, आ, अम् (according to some
fr. rt. 1. शि or fr. rt. 2. श्री, ‘to cook’), Ved. piercing,
burning; an epithet of Agni, (according to Nirukta
IV. 14

. fr. rt. 1. शी, and explained by अनुशयिन् or
वासिन्, which Sāy. interprets to mean ‘sleeping or
lying in the sacrifices.’)
—शीर-शोचिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved.
having burning or piercing splendor, gleaming like
lightning, (Sāy. = शयन-स्वभाव-रोचिष्क, ‘he
whose brilliance has the character of lying or sleep-
ing,’ or अशन-शील-ज्वाल, ‘he whose flame has the
character of pervading.’)

सिर सिर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. सि; but
cf. शिर, शिरा, p. 1006), the root of long pepper;
(आ), f. any tubular vessel of the body, a nerve, vein,
artery, tendon, &c. (see शिरा); a stream, water (Ved.,
Sāy. सिरासु = सरण-शीलास्व् अप्सु, Ṛg-veda
; in Naigh.

. सिरा is enumerated among
the उदक-नामानि; cf. सीरा); a bucket, a baling-
vessel.
—सिरा-जाल, अस्, m. a network or plexus of
vessels or veins, an enlargement of the vessels of
the eye.
—सिरा-मोक्ष, अस्, m. ‘lossing the veins,’
venesection.
—सिरा-व्यध, अस्, m. or सिरा-व्य-
धन, अम्, n. ‘piercing the veins,’ venesection.
—सिरा-हर्ष, अस्, m. thrill of the nerves; a flow of
discoloured tears (according to some).
—सिरोत्पात
(˚रा-उत्˚), अस्, m. disease or morbid affection of the
veins, &c.; redness and inflammation of the eyes.
सीर सीर, अस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s.
II. 25

. said
to be fr. rt. सि; cf. सीता), a plough; the sun; N. of
a Vedic god, (see शुना-सीरौ); the Arka plant;
(अम्), n., Ved. a plough.
—सीर-देव, अस्, m., N.
of a grammarian.
—सीर-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘plough-
bannered,’ N. of Janaka (father of Sītā, q. v.).
—सीर-
पाणि, इस्, m. ‘plough-handed,’ epithet of Bala-rāma
(as armed with a weapon like a plough-share).
—सीर-
भृत्, त्, m. ‘plough-bearer,’ Bala-rāma; [cf. हल-
भृत्.]
—सीर-योग, अस्, m. the yoking of cattle to
a plough or a team so yoked.

सीरा, आस्, f. pl., Ved. streams, waters, rivers, (Sāy.
= नदीः, Ṛg-veda
; in Naigh.

. enu-
merated among the नदी-नामानि; cf. सिरा.)

शिरस् शिरस्, अस्, n. (originally शरस् = क-
रस्; according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. श्रि), the
head; the skull; the top of a tree; the head or top
of anything, highest part, (जानु-शिरस्, the knee-
pan); highest point, pinnacle, acme; the fore part,
front; the van of an army; chief, principal; [cf.
Zend śara, śāranh; Gr. κάρα, κάρ, κάρη-νο-ν,
[]
κρανίο-ν, κέρας; Lat. cere-bru-m, cere-bru-m, cer-vix, cra-
nium, perhaps calva; Goth. hvair-n-ei, haurn;
Old Germ. hirni, horn; Angl. Sax. hœrnes; Lith.
karczei, szerai; Hib. ceann.]
—शिरः-कपालिन्,
ई, m. an ascetic or religious mendicant who carries
about a human skull (as a symbol of abandoning all
worldly desires).
—शिरः-पीडा, f. ‘head-pain,’ head-
ache.
—शिरः-प्रणाम, अस्, m. bowing or bending
the head.
—शिरः-प्रावरण, अम्, n. ‘head-cover-
ing,’ a head-dress, turban.
—शिरः-फल, अस्, m.
‘having fruit on the top,’ the cocoa-nut tree.
—शि-
रः-शूल, अम्, n. head-ache, sharp pain in the head.
—शिरः-श्रेणि, इस्, m. f. a line of heads, number of
heads.
—शिरः-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being on the head.
—शिरः-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has bathed his
head.
—शिरश्-छेद, अस्, m. or शिरश्-छेदन, अम्,
n. cutting off the head, decapitation.
—शिरसि-ज, अस्,
m. ‘head-produced,’ the hair of the head.
—शिरसिज-
पाश, अस्, m. a tuft or quantity of hair.
—शिरसि-रुह्,
ट्, or शिरसि-रुह, अस्, m. ‘head-growing,’ the hair of
the head.
—शिरस्-तस्, ind. from the head.
—शिरस्-
तापिन्, ई, m. an elephant.
—शिरस्-त्र or शिरस्-
त्राण, अम्, n. ‘head-protector,’ a helmet; a cap,
turban, head-dress.
—शिरस्-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being
on the head, being on the summit, at the top, &c.;
(अस्), m. a chief, leader.
—शिरो-गृह, अम्, n. top
room, a room on the top of the house, upper cham-
ber, a turret.
—शिरो-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘head-seizure,’
disease or affection of the head.
—शिरो-ग्रीव, अम्,
n. the head and neck.
—शिरो-धरा, f. or शिरो-धि,
इस्, m. ‘head-supporting,’ the neck.
—शिरो-भू-
षण, अम्, n. an ornament for the head.
—शिरो-
मणि, इस्, m. ‘crest-jewel,’ a gem worn in a head-
ornament or any jewel worn on the head; a title of
respect conferred on Pandits; N. of the author of
the Dīdhiti commentary (so called after its author
Raghunātha-śiromaṇi-bhaṭṭācārya).
—शिरो-मर्-
मन्, आ, m. a hog.
—शिरो-मालिन्, ई, m. ‘garlanded
with skulls,’ epithet of Śiva.
—शिरो-रत्न, अम्, n.
‘crest-gem,’ a jewel worn on the head.
—शिरो-रुजा,
f. ‘head-pain,’ any pain or ache in the head; a kind
of tree (= सप्त-पर्ण, the leaves of which are
used as a remedy for head-ache).
—शिरो-रुह्, ट्, or
शिरो-रुह, अस्, m. ‘head-growing,’ the hair of the
head, hair.
—शिरो-रोग, अस्, m. ‘head-sickness,’ any
pain or disease of the head.
—शिरो-ऽर्ति (˚रस्-अर्˚),
इस्, f. ‘head-pain,’ pain in the head, head-ache, &c.
—शिरो-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being at the head, being
on the top or summit; (ई), m. a chief, any one at
the head of affairs, the general of an army.
—शिरो-
वल्ली, f. the crest or comb of a peacock, (said to be
also read शिरो-वन्दि.)
—शिरो-वृत्त, अम्, n. pepper.
—शिरोवृत्त-फल, अस्, m. a kind of Achyranthes
Aspera (= रक्तापामार्ग).
—शिरो-वेष्ट, अस्, m.
or शिरो-वेष्टन, अम्, n. ‘head-cincture,’ ‘head-
covering,’ a head-dress, turban, cap.
—शिरो-ऽस्थि
(˚रस्-अस्˚), इ, n. ‘head-bone,’ the skull.
—शिरो-
हारिन्, ई, m. epithet of Śiva.

शिरस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the head, being
on the head; (अम्), n. a helmet; a cap, turban,
&c.; (आ), f. a palanquin.

शिरस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the head, being
on the head; (अस्), m. clean or unentangled hair
(= शीर्षण्य).

शिराल, अस्, आ, अम्, veiny, tendinous, sinewy,
skinny, full of tendons or veins; (अम्), n. the acid
fruit of the Averrhoa Carambola (= कर्म-रङ्ग).

शिरालक, अस्, m. the plant Vitis Quadrangularis
(= अस्थि-भङ्ग).
शिरि शिरि, इस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. शॄ), a murderer, killer; a sword; an
arrow; a locust.

शिरिणा, f., Ved. night, (Sāy. शीर्यते ऽस्याम् भु-
तानीति शिरिणा रात्रिः, Ṛg-veda

शिरीष, अस्, m. a kind of tree, Acacia Sirisa;
(अम्), n. the flower of this tree.
—शिरीष-पत्-
त्रिका, f. a white kind of the plant Kiṇihī, q. v.

शिरिम्बिठ शिरिम्बिठ, अस्, m., N. of a Vedic
Ṛṣi (having the patronymic Bhāradvāja and author
of the hymn Ṛg-veda
शीरिन्, ई, m. a kind of plant (= हरिद्-गर्भ).

सीरिन्, ई, m. ‘having or holding a plough,’ epithet
of Bala-rāma, (see above.)

शीर्ण शीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शॄ), withered,
shriveled, shrunk, dry, sere, decayed, rotten; thin,
wasted, emaciated, small, slender, broken off, shivered,
shattered, injured; (अम्), n. a sort of perfume (=
स्थौणेयक).
—शीर्ण-ता, f. ‘having a shriveled
or slender stem,’ or शीर्ण-त्व, अम्, n. the state of
being withered or decayed, a withered condition,
emaciation.
—शीर्ण-नाला, f. the plant Hemionites
Cordifolia (= शीर्ण-माला).
—शीर्ण-पत्त्र, अम्, n.
a withered leaf; (अस्, आ, अम्), having withered or
shriveled leaves; (अस्), m. the tree Pterospermum
Acerifolium; a kind of Lodhra (= पट्टिका-लोध्र);
the Nimb tree.
—शीर्ण-पर्ण, अम्, n. a withered
leaf; (अस्, आ, अम्), having withered or shriveled
leaves; (अस्), m. the Nimb tree.
—शीर्ण-पाद,
अस्, m. a thin foot; ‘having shriveled feet,’ epithet
of Yama (said to have become so in consequence of
his mother's curse).
—शीर्ण-पुष्पिका, f. a kind
of fennel, Anethum Sowa.
—शीर्ण-माल, अस्, आ,
अम्, having a withered garland; (आ), f. a kind of
plant (= शीर्ण-नाला).
—शीर्ण-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्,
having withered roots, withered at the root.
—शीर्ण-
वृन्त, अम्, n. ‘slender-stalked,’ a water-melon.
—शीर्णाङ्घ्रि (˚ण-अङ्˚), इस्, m. ‘having shriveled
feet,’ epithet of Yama.

शीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, withered, &c. See s. v.,
p. 1011, col. 1.

सीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to Śabda-k.) hurt,
injured.
शीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken or shattered.

शीर्त शीर्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्रि), Ved.
served.
शीर्वि शीर्वि, इस्, इस्, इ (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 54

. fr. rt. शॄ), destructive, hurtful, injurious,
mischievous, malignant; savage.

शीर्ष शीर्ष, अम्, n. (an abbreviated form
of शीर्षन्, col. 2), the head, skull; black Agallochum
or aloe wood (= कृष्णागुरु); [cf. probably Lat.
collum; Old Germ. and Angl. Sax. hals.]
—शीर्-
ष-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking the head; beheading,
decapitating.
—शीर्ष-च्छेद, अस्, m. or शीर्ष-
च्छेदन, अम्, n. the act of cutting off the head,
decapitating, decapitation.
—शीर्षच्छेदिक, अस्, ई,
अम्, deserving decapitation.
—शीर्ष-च्छेदिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, cutting off the head, decapitating.
—शीर्ष-
च्छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be beheaded, meriting death
by decapitation.
—शीर्ष-रक्ष, अम्, n. ‘head-
protector,’ a helmet.
—शीर्ष-शोक, अस्, m. pain in
the head.
—शीर्षामय (˚ष-आम्˚), अस्, m. disease
[]
or morbid affection of the head.
—शीर्षावशेषी-
कृ (˚ष-अव्˚), cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to leave
only the head undestroyed.
—शीर्षोदय (˚ष-
उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘head-rising’ or ‘rising in front,’ epi-
thet of the zodiacal signs Gemini, Leo, Virgo, Libra,
Scorpio, Aquarius, and Pisces.

शीर्षक, अम्, n. the head, skull; a helmet; a
cap, hat; judgment, award, verdict, sentence, result
of judicial investigation; (अस्), m., N. of Rāhu (the
personified ascending node).
—शीर्षक-स्थ, अस्,
आ, अम्, being in or on the head, staying on the
head; abiding by an award or verdict, submitting
to the penalty imposed.

शीर्षक्ति, इस्, f. (probably fr. शीर् = शीर्ष + सक्ति),
Ved. a pain or affection in the head.

शीर्षण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the head
(Ved.); (अम्), n. a helmet; a cap; a rope fastened
to a horse's head, head-rope, halter (Ved.); (अस्), m.
clean and unentangled hair; [cf. शिरस्य.]

शीर्षन्, अ, n. (connected with शिरस्, but not
declined in the later language except in acc. pl. and
remaining cases, where it may be optionally substi-
tuted for शिरस्; it is also used in some comps., e. g.
सहस्र-श्˚), the head; any eminent or illustrious
person (Ved., e. g. शीर्ष्णे-शीर्ष्णे = श्रेष्ठाय
श्रेष्ठाय, to every eminent person, Ṛg-veda
सीरक, अस्, m. a plough; the sun; a porpoise.
सीरज सीरज, N. of a place.
सीर्णि, इस्, f. (according to Śabda-k.) injury, hurt.
